messages:
Mia: quick sync — following the postmortem, recurring cross-region TLS+retry spikes need dedicated follow-ups. p95 tls handshake timeouts precede routing retries by ~30s. 
Ajay: same pattern here. noticed cold hosts in eu-west have higher accept CPU ~ and longer TLS setup. 
Sam: ALB healthcheck flaps coincide (small sample) and trigger host shuffling. 
Taylor: any packet captures? need to check tcp retransmits vs tls failure reasons. 
Mia: uploaded pcaps from 2026-03-21 02:14 UTC: https://redwood.internal/pm/2623460000/pcap (internal link). 
Olivia: infra-bot fired auto-eject for tls-handshake-timeout at 02:14 and removed 3 hosts; that likely amplified churn. 
infra-bot: alert: tls-handshake-timeout (p90 8.1s > 5s) — automated ejection executed. 
Ajay: proposed immediate remediation: 1) disable auto-eject threshold for inter-region spikes (owner: Ajay), 2) LB TLS accept timeout -> 10s (owner: Sam), 3) run low-traffic canary and observe (owner: Taylor). target dates: short-term (Mar 30). 
Sam: preparing envoy patch to bump idle/accept timeouts: 
```yaml
listener_protocol_options:
  tcp_keepalive: true
  idle_timeout: 10s
```
Taylor: can run canary Thu 02:00 UTC; will watch p50/p95 handshake and routing assignment churn. 
Mia: add these to postmortem follow-ups and update runbook: avoid automated ejection during transient cross-region TLS anomalies. 
Ajay: logging action items here:
- [ ] disable-auto-eject (owner: Ajay) due: 2026-03-30
- [ ] lb-tls-timeout-update (owner: Sam) due: 2026-03-30
- [ ] canary-and-observe (owner: Taylor) due: 2026-03-31
- [ ] update-postmortem-and-runbook (owner: Olivia) due: 2026-03-29
- [ ] deep-rca-cold-host-handshake (owners: Ajay, Sam) due: 2026-04-14
Mia: tagging @oncall-team for awareness, please ack ownership or raise blockers. 
Taylor: ack, will escalate if regressions seen. 
Olivia: ack — I'll sync with CS if customers report latency. 
Sam: will post PR link when LB patch is ready. 
Ajay: please update this thread after each step so we have a clear trail for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
